evidence: Labeled P2P and changes connection management and transaction broadcast state in src/private_broadcast.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Prevents adversaries from deanonymizing private broadcasts via a timing side channel that canceled remaining outbound connections if a transaction returned early. The p2p definition prioritizes resistance to attack and privacy of transaction origin, and leaving this privacy-compromising side channel unaddressed across releases undermines private broadcast security.
